page.notes: The top Arabic line is faint and only partly legible; the reading given is uncertain and marked [?]. The lower Arabic verse is set in a clear hand but is copied from the scan, not from memory; its final words are marked [?]. A circular stamp of the Oxford-style library type is at the right of the title, and a small round stamp in the upper right of the page; a woodcut arms/device stands at the left of the centre block and a crowned cross-shaped device at the right. Neither device nor stamp is printed text and both are omitted. The ornamental border is also omitted. "Cameterio" is printed as shown (for Coemeterio). Nothing printed appears below the imprint.
